Down the Rabbit Hole AUST is owned and run by Michael Robinson, fully insured and ABN registered, and every garden maintenance Canberra quote is free and given upfront.

sections.h2: How the schedule changes through the year
paras: Canberra gardens are shaped by hard frosts from May to August, a spring growth surge from September and hot, dry summers. Spring visits are heavy on weeding as beds wake up and weeds arrive with the warmth. Summer visits focus on mulch, light pruning and keeping paths clear with water restrictions in mind.

Autumn leaf drop from deciduous street trees fills gutters, beds and paths for weeks, so those visits are mostly raking and bagging. Winter visits are lighter and less frequent. Garden maintenance Canberra wide follows this rhythm, which is why a fixed schedule still shifts its focus with the season.

faqs.q: How often should garden maintenance be scheduled?
faqs.a: Fortnightly from spring to autumn and monthly through winter suits most Canberra properties. Smaller or low-maintenance gardens may only need a monthly visit all year. The frequency can be changed at any time.

faqs.q: Can you maintain a strata complex or body corporate property?
faqs.a: Yes. Common areas for unit and townhouse complexes can be maintained on a fixed cycle, from a scope agreed upfront with the strata manager or committee.

faqs.q: Do you maintain rental property gardens for property managers?
faqs.a: Yes. Rentals can go on a standing schedule so the garden stays presentable for tenants and routine inspections. Access can be arranged with the tenant or property manager.

faqs.q: Is green waste removal available with garden maintenance?
faqs.a: Yes. Green waste removal is available with every garden maintenance visit, so prunings, weeds and leaves do not have to go in your green bin. For bigger loads, see our green waste removal service.

faqs.q: Can I book a single garden tidy instead of a schedule?
faqs.a: Garden maintenance is for recurring visits. For a single job, such as a garden bed makeover or a big prune, book our gardening services instead.
